# ECN-2026-044 Change notice - Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P3, line P3-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L2-RR02

Reason for change
-----------------
Background: During recent maintenance and inspection activities on Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02), field maintenance personnel identified variability in mandrel seating and clamp stability that could contribute to off-axis runout and accelerated wear of the mandrel assembly. Investigation of assembly records, tool usage, and operator feedback indicated inconsistent clamp bolt preload as a likely contributor. The current documentation and work instructions referenced for clamp procedures did not specify a controlled target torque value for the mandrel clamp bolts for this specific machine, leading to inconsistent practice across shifts.

Purpose: This engineering change notice establishes a defined mandrel clamp bolt torque value for EQ-P3-L2-RR02 and documents the implementation and control measures required to standardize clamp preload during mandrel installation and maintenance. The change aims to reduce mandrel movement during rolling, improve dimensional stability of produced rings, and extend service life of mandrel-related components.

Supporting documents: Procedure and operational references to be used in conjunction with this change are SOP-P3-L2-01, SOP-P3-L2-03, and SOP-P3-L2-04. These procedures will be revised as noted in the implementation section to incorporate the new torque requirement and associated verification steps.

Affected items
--------------
- Equipment: Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02).  
- Assemblies: Mandrel clamp bolts and adjacent clamp hardware used to secure the mandrel to the headstock.  
- Procedures: Work instructions and standard operating procedures covering mandrel installation, clamp torqueing, and pre-roll checks associated with EQ-P3-L2-RR02 (see SOP-P3-L2-01, SOP-P3-L2-03, SOP-P3-L2-04).  
- Records: Maintenance and inspection records, torque verification logs, and shift handover checklists where mandrel installation is recorded.

Mandrel clamp bolt torque specification
---------------------------------------
The mandrel clamp bolt torque for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02) is 475 N·m.

Implementation
--------------
Scope and applicability: This torque requirement applies whenever the mandrel is installed, reinstalled, removed and reinstalled after any mandrel service, or whenever clamp hardware is replaced or adjusted on EQ-P3-L2-RR02. The value is to be used as the target torque for final clamp bolt tightening when following the mandated tightening sequence and verification steps described below.

Procedure revisions: Update SOP-P3-L2-01, SOP-P3-L2-03, and SOP-P3-L2-04 to include:
- The specified mandrel clamp bolt torque value and the note that this value applies only to EQ-P3-L2-RR02.
- A prescribed tightening sequence for the clamp bolts to ensure even preload distribution (mechanics will follow the existing sequence patterns in the SOPs and annotate the change in the revision notes).
- A requirement that final torque be applied using a calibrated torque wrench or torque-control tool capable of delivering and documenting the specified value.
- Acceptance criteria for torque verification and instructions for corrective action if torque readings are out of tolerance, including re-torqueing and inspection of clamp threads and seating surfaces.

Tightening and verification steps (summary for incorporation into SOPs):
- Clean clamp bolt threads and seating surfaces, inspect for damage, and apply any specified assembly lubricant per the existing SOPs.
- Hand-start bolts and perform an initial snug sequence to seat the clamp.
- Apply the specified torque value to each clamp bolt following the prescribed sequence.
- Record the torque reading for each bolt in the torque verification log for the event.
- If any bolt cannot achieve the specified torque, stop installation, tag the clamp for inspection, and escalate to maintenance for thread or clamp surface evaluation before resuming.

Tools and calibration: Use calibrated torque wrenches or torque-controlled tools. Tool calibration records must be current and available for audit. Torque tool identification must be added to the torque verification log so that torque events can be traced to specific tools and calibration certificates.

Training and communication: Conduct targeted training for maintenance technicians and operators who perform mandrel changeover or clamp adjustments on EQ-P3-L2-RR02. Training will cover the revised SOP content, the rationale for the torque requirement, the tightening sequence, and required recordkeeping.

Examples and rationale: Examples of corrective actions include re-torqueing with a calibrated tool when a clamp shows evidence of movement during a trial roll or when torque logs indicate deviation from the specified value. Rationale: consistent clamp preload minimizes clamp loosening under operational loading, reduces eccentric loading on the mandrel, and lowers the risk of localized wear that could lead to mandrel failure or out-of-spec product.

Records to keep
---------------
- Torque verification log for each mandrel installation or reinstallation on EQ-P3-L2-RR02. The log must list the equipment id, the mandrel serial or identifier if applicable, the clamp bolt identification, the applied torque value, the torque tool id, operator or technician initials, and any corrective actions performed.
- Tool calibration certificate copies for torque tools used on EQ-P3-L2-RR02.
- Revised procedure records and training completion records referencing SOP-P3-L2-01, SOP-P3-L2-03, and SOP-P3-L2-04 updates.
- Maintenance work orders and inspection reports documenting any clamp or thread repairs that were required as a result of torque verification findings.

Approvals
---------
Implementation of this change requires approval from the equipment reliability engineer and the plant maintenance manager. Approval signatures will be appended to this ECN in the document control system and recorded with links to the revised SOP entries for SOP-P3-L2-01, SOP-P3-L2-03, and SOP-P3-L2-04. After approvals, the revised SOPs will be released and training scheduled to ensure compliance.

Notes
-----
This ECN is specific to EQ-P3-L2-RR02. Any changes for other ring rolling mills must be processed via separate engineering change notices and appropriate updates to their operating procedures. Refer to SOP-P3-L2-01, SOP-P3-L2-03, and SOP-P3-L2-04 for existing installation and safety requirements that remain in force unless explicitly superseded by this notice.
